# ohos is an independent target that also selects the Linux syscall ABI.
env GOOS=ohos
env GOARCH=arm64
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go list -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' .
stdout '^abi_linux_arm64.go main.go platform_ohos.go unix.go$'
env GODEBUG=goindex=0
go list -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' .
stdout '^abi_linux_arm64.go main.go platform_ohos.go unix.go$'
go build -o app .
go version -m app
stdout 'GOOS=ohos'
stdout 'GOARCH=arm64'
stdout 'CGO_ENABLED=0'

# Pure-Go PIE is supported, and still reports the independent target.
go build -buildmode=pie -o app-pie .
go version -m app-pie
stdout 'GOOS=ohos'

# Native-library/race modes require a target C toolchain.
! go build -buildmode=c-shared .
stderr 'requires external .cgo. linking, but cgo is not enabled'
! go build -race .
stderr '-race requires cgo'

# The OHOS race shadow cannot represent high-address shared-library data.
env CGO_ENABLED=1
! go build -race -buildmode=c-shared .
stderr '-race with -buildmode=c-shared is not supported on ohos/arm64'
! go build -race -buildmode=plugin .
stderr '-race with -buildmode=plugin is not supported on ohos/arm64'
! go build -race -linkshared .
stderr '-race with -linkshared is not supported on ohos/arm64'
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# The alias is one-way: Linux does not select ohos-only files.
env GOOS=linux
go list -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' .
stdout '^abi_linux_arm64.go excluded_linux.go main.go unix.go$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/ohos

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import "runtime"

func main() {
	if runtime.GOOS != "ohos" || !ohosTarget || !linuxABI || !unixTarget {
		panic("incorrect platform")
	}
}
-- platform_ohos.go --
package main

const ohosTarget = true
-- abi_linux_arm64.go --
package main

const linuxABI = true
-- unix.go --
//go:build unix

package main

const unixTarget = true
-- excluded_linux.go --
//go:build linux && !ohos

package main

var _ = mustNotBuildOnOhos
-- excluded_android.go --
package main

var _ = mustNotBuildOnOhos
-- excluded_ohos_amd64.go --
package main

var _ = mustNotBuildOnArm64
